advancements.solomod.absolute_dissonance: Silence your hungry half, break the code of the Song and leave the Throne Empty.
advancements.solomod.born_in_silence.des: Everything that lives sings in four Voices. You were born with none — and plenty of room to spare.
advancements.solomod.broken_guard.descri: The knights of the Courts swore to protect five thrones. None of them remember who the thrones were afraid of.
advancements.solomod.broken_guard.title: Broken Guard
advancements.solomod.chains_for_nobody.d: Defeat Cinzagrim. He forged the chains of the Seal and never asked for whom.
advancements.solomod.empty_tide.descript: The trenches have no king. The tentacles sink back into the lock.
advancements.solomod.empty_tide.title: Empty Tide
advancements.solomod.error_sixth_voice.d: The Song is over. What lived in the noise outside just noticed the open door.
advancements.solomod.faithful_to_the_end: Defeat the Echo Hunter, the only servant who never betrayed the Sovereign.
advancements.solomod.first_strike.descri: The giant who struck the first blow has fallen. The right arm of stone sinks back into the Seal.
advancements.solomod.first_strike.title: The First Strike
advancements.solomod.five_lineages_harmo: Bond a serene Echo of each lineage: Silence, Fire, Water, Earth and Air.
advancements.solomod.frame_jump.descript: Be pulled out of the Sovereign's Chest Beam by the Dimensional Rift Moth's blink.
advancements.solomod.frame_jump.title: Frame Jump
advancements.solomod.lie_of_five_thrones: Defeat the 6 Sanctuary guardians and learn that the heroes of the story were the thieves.
advancements.solomod.mirror_face.descrip: A thirty-meter Hunger looks at the Will in mortal flesh. Two pieces of a single god.
advancements.solomod.mirror_face.title: Face to Face in the Mirror
advancements.solomod.muscle_memory.descr: You are not learning to fight. Your body is remembering how immense it once was.
advancements.solomod.muscle_memory.title: Muscle Memory
advancements.solomod.necessary_silence.d: Spend all of a companion's charges until Exhaustion. Even an Echo needs a rest between notes.
advancements.solomod.red_whisper.descrip: When the counselors bleed, the Voice inside them tries to flee back into the abyss.
advancements.solomod.red_whisper.title: The Red Whisper
advancements.solomod.returned_fever.desc: The furnace has cooled. The leg of magma crosses the earth toward its true owner.
advancements.solomod.severed_root.descri: Not all the wood in the world could hold what was stolen. The amber leg breaks free.
advancements.solomod.severed_root.title: Severed Root
advancements.solomod.shattered_seal.desc: You returned every piece to the cell. It was no accident: you always knew how to open your own cage.
advancements.solomod.song_of_guilt.descr: Defeat the Weeper. She did not mourn the drowned: she mourned what she helped to drown.
advancements.solomod.song_of_guilt.title: Song of Guilt
advancements.solomod.soul_tuning_fork.de: Bond your first serene Echo. It does not obey you: it remembers you.
advancements.solomod.stone_heart.descrip: Defeat the Root Mother, who turned to stone so she would not let go of what she anchored.
advancements.solomod.stone_heart.title: Heart of Stone
advancements.solomod.swallowed_scream.de: Defeat the Herald. The call that united the five thieves will never echo again.
advancements.solomod.taste_of_violence.d: Animals die quietly. Monsters die with spite. Swallow your first Echo of violence.
advancements.solomod.the_first_choir.des: Record all 15 serene Echoes. Before the theft, this is how your chest sounded.
advancements.solomod.usurper_fall.descri: The silver wings tear through the clouds one last time. The five thieves have paid their debt.
advancements.solomod.usurper_fall.title: Fall of the Usurper
Defeat the Archivist, the accomplice who split a soul in two and threw the empty half into the world.
advancements.solomod.what_is_dead_cannot: Watch a companion enter Astral Form. The world cannot kill what has already died.
book.solomod.guide.page_1:
Echoes of Awakening

The cover bears no name. Among the worn pages, one line survived the damp:

"Everything that lives sings.
Not everything that sings
is still alive."
book.solomod.guide.page_2:
Before walls and roads, there was a Song.

Water carried it. Fire gave it breath. Earth kept its rhythm, and the wind took it far away.
book.solomod.guide.page_3:
When a life ended, something of it remained.

A gesture. A wish. A memory unable to rest.

The ancients gave a name to what lingered:

Echo.
book.solomod.guide.page_4:
The records speak of a time when the Song could be heard in full.

Then pages are missing. The next begins halfway through a sentence:

"...and no one ever sang that name again."
book.solomod.guide.page_5:
Kingdoms came. Walls rose upon stones older than their histories.

Songs passed from mouth to mouth.

But certain verses were already sung only in whispers.
book.solomod.guide.page_6:
Some Echoes are gentle, as light as dreams.

Others cling to the world like a wound.

No one knows whether they seek something... or simply cannot leave.
book.solomod.guide.page_7:
Near the end, the handwriting changes.

"Tonight I dreamed of a voice. By morning I had forgotten its words.

Still, I spent the morning afraid I might recognize it."
book.solomod.guide.page_8:
The last page was torn out. In the margin that remains, the ink pierced the paper:

"I never told anyone my name.

How did it know?"
book.solomod.guide.title: Echoes of Awakening
credits.solomod.epilogue.1: Ages ago, five thieves dismembered the First Choir and called it a kingdom.
credits.solomod.epilogue.2: You returned every stolen piece and silenced the Hunger that remained.
credits.solomod.epilogue.3: The Song is over. Something outside heard the crack.
credits.solomod.epilogue.4: And an empty throne does not stay empty for long...
credits.solomod.subtitle: Test version
credits.solomod.title: SOLO MOD
dialogue.solomod.sovereign.death.1: You... defeated the Hunger. But look at your hands, Awakened...
dialogue.solomod.sovereign.death.2: The Seal did not hold only me... My Song kept the OUTSIDE locked. Now that I am silent... who will stop THEM from coming through the tear?
dialogue.solomod.sovereign.exhausted: Missing... your half is missing... My chest cannot hold the choir alone...
dialogue.solomod.sovereign.intro: Five thrones have fallen... five thieves have bled. You carried my arms, my legs, my breath back to the lock. Come closer, little empty vessel... give back the rest.
dialogue.solomod.sovereign.laugh.1: Hahaha... Not yet worthy! A mortal husk could never bear the weight of our crown!
dialogue.solomod.sovereign.laugh.2: Hahaha... Back to dust, empty half. When you wake again, bring a greater Echo to my table.
dialogue.solomod.sovereign.laugh.3: Hahaha... Even without memory, you fight like me. But Hunger always beats Will!
dialogue.solomod.sovereign.speaker: Sovereign
dialogue.solomod.sovereign.stage.1.start: The Colossus used my right arm to crush kingdoms... Watch how stone obeys its true owner!
dialogue.solomod.sovereign.stage.1.trans: Argh... These tendons still reject the stitching! And you... you move like someone who knows the weight of my hand.
dialogue.solomod.sovereign.stage.2.start: The Volcanic King warmed his throne with the blood of my chest! Burn in the fever they left me with in the dark!
dialogue.solomod.sovereign.stage.2.trans: The fire does not consume you... You have no Voice, yet you swallow violence the way I did. What did the Archivist do to you?!
dialogue.solomod.sovereign.stage.3.start: They drowned me beneath the Weeper's sobbing and called it justice! Feel the pressure of a thousand years at the bottom of the abyss!
dialogue.solomod.sovereign.stage.3.trans: Wait... That silence inside your chest... You are no ordinary vessel. You are the piece they tore from my mind so I could not open the door from within!
dialogue.solomod.sovereign.stage.4.start: You are my Will! And I am your Hunger! Stop fighting your own flesh — let the roots stitch us back together!
dialogue.solomod.sovereign.stage.4.trans: Fool! If you destroy me, who will hold the Song?! The five usurpers are dead... there is no one left but us!
dialogue.solomod.sovereign.stage.5.start: The Emperor took my wings so I would crawl in the mud! If you refuse to be one with me willingly, I will tear my soul out of your frail body!
dialogue.solomod.sovereign.stage.5.trans: NO! The code... the melody is tearing! If I fall, the Silence wins! HEAR EVERY VOICE AT ONCE!
item.solomod.dissonance_shard.tooltip: It does not vibrate in Water, Fire, Earth, Air or Silence. It is waiting for reality's next update.
